en: <CLT=cltMIND>When we left the hidden room...

<CLT=cltMIND>we saw Keebo and the Exisal
in a fierce battle!
Ah! Ugh...
Are you alright!? Are either of you injured!?
I-I'm okay...
Wh-What!?

<CLT=cltMIND>The hidden door has been
blocked by rubble!
H-Himiko!

I'm sorry! I'm relieved that you two are not
hurt.
H-Hold on... Himiko is...!
<CLT=cltMIND>H-Himiko!
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>H-Himiko!
<CLT=cltMIND>H-Himiko!
<CLT=cltMIND>H-Himiko!
<CLT=cltMIND>H-Himiko!
<CLT=cltMIND>H-Himiko!
<CLT=cltMIND>H-Himiko!

<CLT=cltMIND>I have an idea...
I know how to find the mastermind!
<CLT=cltMIND>H-Himiko!
<CLT=cltMIND>H-Himiko!
<CLT=cltMIND>H-Himiko!
<CLT=cltMIND>I can't get through the rubble!
<CLT=cltMIND>H-Himiko!

<CLT=cltMIND>The hidden door has been blocked
by rubble! We can't get in or out!
I-Is...Himiko trapped?
I-I think so...
Keebo, can you do something!?

I can destroy the debris, but without knowing
Himiko's status...

It could be dangerous for me to just
recklessly attack it.

Th-Then...are you saying we should 
just leave her there?
I couldn't do such a thing! We're friends!

But I'm not strong enough to lift the
debris...
...Let's use the Exisal.
What?
Use the Exisal...? How?

We don't have any more of Miu's inventions,
and the Monokubs are in the Exisals—

Exactly. We're going to get Monokuma
and the Monokubs to do it.
...Monokuma and the Monokubs?

They don't want this either. Their objective
is to continue the killing game...

Are you suggesting that we surrender to
them, and continue the killing game!?

But Himiko is in danger! Rescuing her 
should be our first—

No. We're going to *end* this
killing game.

...What do you mean? Do you have a plan
of some sort?

Yes, I do. It just requires a little bit
of detective work...
We need to investigate some more.
Huh? What about Himiko?

...I'm worried about her, but we have to
trust that she's okay right now.

We trusted her when she said to
leave everything to her.

If we just stand around here,
we're not respecting her wishes.
O-Okay... Himiko is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Magician<CLT=typeNORMAL>...

I bet she'll use her magic to find a clue
in that room that's just plain amazing.
Yeah, I'm sure Himiko is okay.

If you're in search of clues, I would
investigate the classroom on the 2nd floor...
Huh?

I caught a glimpse of something odd there
while battling the Exisals in the courtyard.

Whatever clue you're looking for may be
there.
Something odd...

Just hurry! You don't have much time!
It's nearly dawn.
And...I'm worried about Himiko.
Keebo...
But you won't change the time limit...will you?

I can't keep evading the Exisals' attacks
beyond that time limit.
If we don't settle this soon, I'll be destroyed.

And if that happens, we'll lose the chance
to destroy the Ultimate Academy...

That would be the worst ending...
No...
...It would be an ending of pure despair.
<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo...
Tsumugi, I'm going to the second floor.

I don't know if I can get to all of them,
but I'll do what I can!
I'll see you later!

<CLT=cltMIND>With confident steps, Tsumugi
ran out of the library.
<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko...just a little longer...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You have increased your <CLT=cltSTRONG>bond<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!
You can move more debris than before.
<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko...just a little longer...
